goal: Show academic fit, program relevance, and a credible future path.

structure.instruction: State your academic interest and what you want to study.
Summarize relevant education, grades, projects, and skills.
Show how your experience supports the program.
Explain the curriculum, specialization, and academic value.
Mention specific faculty, labs, courses, or resources.
Describe realistic academic or professional goals after completion.
Restate your intent in one short paragraph.

red_flags: Weak connection between previous study and chosen program
Contradictions with the LOA or work history
banned_phrases: I just need a Canadian degree
this course is only for immigration
I have no specific reason beyond Canada
preferred_language: My academic background has prepared me for...
This program aligns with my interest in...
The curriculum offers the specialization I need in...
I intend to build expertise in...
After completing this program, I plan to...
quality_checklist: The course and institution are named clearly
The document matches the rest of the application
